slice: NW ROUTE CORRIDOR (Củ Chi → Trảng Bàng → Gò Dầu → Tây Ninh / Núi Bà Đen). SEPARATE from the other CREATORS_HCMC files.
note: WebSearch-only research from a US region could not surface individual Vietnamese TikTok/YouTube/food-vlogger clips on these specific corridor stops with a *findable* URL and a verifiable follower scale. Per the honesty rule I did NOT invent any creator or follower count. The corridor's places are instead carried by national press and institutional authorities (Việt Nam News, VietnamPlus, VietnamNet, Nhân Dân, SGGP, Saigoneer, Guinness, Wikipedia, Tây Ninh provincial tourism). A follow-up local-language pass (Vietnamese YouTube/TikTok — e.g. searching 'bò tơ Xuân Đào review', 'bánh canh Trảng Bàng Út Huệ', 'Núi Bà Đen cáp treo') is the way to attach named vloggers with follower counts.
